caption: The image is a monochrome drawing or print of a decorative, arched panel bordered by intricate leafy scrollwork and patterns. Inside the arched frame, at the center, stands a robed human figure with a halo, holding a staff or pole in the left hand and touching a vase with a leafy plant with the right hand. To the left of this figure, beside the robes, there is a rectangular object with the letter “B” and a small wheel or gear. The background is dark, while the figures and details are rendered in lighter shades, creating highlights. The top half of the panel features a semicircular ornamental swirl above the central figure’s head. Alongside the figure’s head, the letters “ERVH” are inscribed on the left and “LING” on the right. The entire scene is contained in a frame that has an animal head at the upper left and right corners of the arch, with an elaborate, somewhat floral top center crest. The composition is rendered in shades of brown and gray, typical of a photograph or scan of an engraved or cast metal object.
title: Pa. German Fire Back
